text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the final day of summer camp and Satono Diamond appears to be lost in thought.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I was thinking about the future.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: There's only two months left until the Kikuka Sho. I wonder how much I can improve in that time.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I still don't think I've gained the kind of overwhelming, jinx-defying strength I seek.
choice_data_list: We have two whole months to go.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We spent summer camp focusing on the fundamentals, but we'll begin training for the Kikuka Sho in earnest from here on out.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: You're right. I know that you don't see immediate results from training, but I can't help feeling impatient.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I can't let something so trivial shake me up, though! I won't lose to a jinx! I'm going to win without a doubt!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Okay! I've got a grip on myself again! I'm going to push myself even harder in preparation for the race!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The anxiousness she's feeling must be driven by her intense desire to win the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, her enthusiasm does feel somewhat forced and excessive. I really hope it doesn't end up hindering her progress…
